blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
The pub is like an extension of the London office. When there is good news, people celebrate there. On Fridays, the week ends there.

Colleagues sit together, have a beer, and become friends over a pint. The food is simple and good. The company is warm.

Today we use have and has to order food and drinks, and to talk about the people around the table.

items.q: Where does the London week often end?
items.why: "On Fridays, the week ends there" — "there" = the pub.

items.q: What do colleagues become at the pub?
items.why: "colleagues become friends over a pint."

items.q: How is the pub food described?
items.why: "The food is simple and good."

items.q: The text says the pub is "an extension of the office." This suggests that…
options: work relationships continue at the pub
the pub is inside the office building
people do their job at the pub
items.why: Inferência: o pub não é o escritório, mas os colegas de trabalho seguem juntos lá.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: colleagues should not go to the pub
the pub is a cold and quiet place
the pub is only about food
items.why: Inferência: o texto fala de amizade, calor e companhia — o pub aproxima as pessoas.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emma no pub com os colegas depois do expediente. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, we have a table in the corner. It's a table for four, so we're all here. Good.

Let me get the first round. Tom, what do you want? A pint? Great. Sara has a glass of white wine after work, so I'll get that too. And I'll have a pint as well.

Here is the menu. The fish and chips is very good here. The burger is big and the chips are hot. I always have the fish, but today I want the burger. Tom, you have the fish. It's a classic.

Okay, the drinks are here. Three pints and one wine. We have a long week behind us, and now it's Friday. Let's celebrate. Raise your glass. Cheers, everyone! To a good week, and to good friends. Next round is on Tom!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where is their table?
items.why: "we have a table in the corner."

items.q: What does Sara drink after work?
items.why: "Sara has a glass of white wine after work."

items.q: What does Emma want to eat today?
items.why: "I always have the fish, but today I want the burger."

items.q: How many people are at the table?
items.why: Inferência: "a table for four, so we're all here" — o grupo tem quatro pessoas.

items.q: Who probably pays for the next round?
items.why: Inferência: "Next round is on Tom!" — a próxima rodada é por conta do Tom.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We meet at the pub every Friday." A pub is…
items.why: Pub = bar tradicional britânico.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I'll have a cold ___, please."
items.why: Beer = cerveja; é o que você pede para beber.

items.q: "Can I see the menu, please?" A menu is…
options: the list of food and drinks
items.why: Menu = cardápio, a lista de comidas e bebidas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The waiter takes our ___ and brings the food."
items.why: Order = pedido; é o que o garçom anota.

items.q: "We raise our glasses and say cheers!" Cheers means…
items.why: Cheers = saúde, o que se diz ao brindar.

blocks.instruction: Expressões comuns no pub e no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "This round is on me." A round is…
items.why: Round = uma rodada de bebidas para todo o grupo.

items.q: "Let's grab a drink after work." This means…
options: buy a drink to take home
items.why: Grab a drink = tomar um drink (junto), de forma informal.

items.q: "The next round is on you." This means…
items.why: "On you" = por sua conta, você paga.

items.q: "Let's call it a day and go to the pub." This means…
items.why: Call it a day = encerrar o trabalho por hoje.

items.q: "Cheers! Here's to a good week." This is…
items.why: "Here's to…" = um brinde em celebração a algo.
